description:
draft-ietf-mls-combiner (combiner-02), Wire formats. Editors' copy mlswg/mls-combiner at 380f0e1, L610.

Text: "An APQMessagePair is sent as the payload of an MLSMessage with the"

Problem: The draft never extends the RFC 9420 MLSMessage select with a case for apq_message_pair, so the encoding of the payload is implied rather than defined.

Suggested fix: Show the extended MLSMessage with `case apq_message_pair: APQMessagePair apq_message_pair;`.

Severity: medium. Verifier: narrow (The question of whether the pair format is required or optional is already raised in a comment on open issue #25, so that part is dropped. The missing MLSMessage select case is confirmed against RFC 9420 lines 1551-1565 and is not raised anywhere.)
